title: Kimi ga Shinu made Koi wo Shitai

thread.title: I Want to Love You Till Your Dying Day • Kimi ga Shinu made Koi wo Shitai - Episode 13 discussion - FINAL

opinions.point: Many commenters praised the emotional focus, character writing, voice acting, music, and overall payoff, with some considering the series a standout yuri anime.
Several viewers appreciated the central character’s emotional development and found the episode heartfelt and suitably reflective.
Some liked the character-focused finale but felt it gave limited attention to other major characters.
A few commenters enjoyed the episode while feeling it played more like an epilogue or OVA than a conventional finale.
Multiple commenters were frustrated that English subtitles were unavailable or delayed on Crunchyroll.
Some viewers thought the season ended well but left too many broader story questions unresolved and hoped for another season.

title: LIAR GAME

opinions.point: The episode and season finale were widely praised for clever mind games, surprising turns, and satisfying character progress.
Many commenters especially enjoyed Nao becoming more capable while retaining her kindness, and they were eager for the continuation.
The voice acting and the recurring whisper-focused performance were repeatedly treated as memorable and funny.
Several viewers enjoyed the strategy but felt some schemes were predictable or difficult to follow.
The adaptation was criticized for limited budget and weak animation, though some viewers felt this added charm or fit the source material.
Some viewers thought the early pacing was too slow, while the overall season was still considered entertaining.
